chapters.label: Winner goes through
chapters.text: Wembley, 1999: Arsenal against Fiorentina, and the winner goes through. Heinrich passes to Batistuta, out on the right. One touch to stop it, one past the defender... boom! A thunderbolt into the roof of the net!

chapters.label: The thunderbolt
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Standing foot beside the ball, eyes down, and his leg swings through with all his power.

chapters.label: Batigol
chapters.text: Too fast for David Seaman! Batigol's goal sends Fiorentina through.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: plant your standing foot beside the ball, and strike through it with power!
